messages:
mike: Weekly release train update: small changelog + deprecation heads-up. TL;DR: rolling canary tomorrow 02:00 UTC, removing model:v1 from hosted catalog in two weeks (migration note below).

- ship: improved batching heuristics for short prompts (reduces p95 by ~5%)
- ship: routing proxy patch to improve cold-starts for kv-cache
- note: model:v1 will be sunset 2 weeks from today; teams must pin to model:v2 or request a legacy window.

sophie: ack. Can you share the migration checklist for model:v1 -> v2?

mike: short checklist:
1) run compatibility test suite on canary
2) validate tokenization/embeddings diff < 1% drift for key prompts
3) confirm perf (p95) within 20%
4) submit `releasectl exception` if you need a staged fallback window

dena: we have a downstream rerank pipeline that depends on v1 embeddings. Owner: dena. Requesting a 48h legacy window to validate.

mike: grant 48h legacy window for rerank pipeline (owner: dena). Please post results here.

ops-bot: PRE-FLIGHT CHECKS FOR TOMORROW:
- infra health: ok
- db lag: <250ms
- canary baselines: nominal
- alerting hooks: configured
All green.

oncall: we'll monitor embedding drift and p95 during the canary. Post 10-min updates in thread.

mike: scheduling: canary tilt at 02:00 UTC -> run for 90m. Fallback policy active: if error-rate > 1% or p95 > 2s for 3 consecutive windows, auto-reroute to model:stable and pause rollouts.

deploy-bot: Scheduled tasks: add-console-banner (2147895600), canary-tilt (2147896800). Exception created for rerank legacy window (RTX-999).

sophie: thanks. I'll publish the migration checklist in the release dashboard and ping teams.

mike: thanks everyone. Post any migration blockers here; escalate to @oncall if urgent. :thumbsup:
